item.title: Show HN: I built a simple free app that helps control ADHD symptoms
item.summary: I built this small app that helps improve ADHD symptoms by making you look at a blank screen, it tracks your gaze and ensures you don't look away. I use it while vibe coding isntead of looking at social media. It's free on desktop and mobile Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49399282 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
